item.title: [LU-21175] "rpmbuild -ba --with=mofed" failed with doca 3.2
item.description:
eaujames@rocky10:~/rpmbuild$ rpmbuild -ba --with=mofed SPECS/lustre.spec
...
Shell debugging temporarily silenced: export LMOD_SH_DBG_ON=1 for Lmod's output                   
Shell debugging restarted                           
+ unset __lmod_sh_dbg                               
+ return 0                                          
+ export PRTE_MCA_rmaps_default_mapping_policy=:oversubscribe                                     
+ PRTE_MCA_rmaps_default_mapping_policy=:oversubscribe                                            
+ WITH_KFI=                                         
+ WITH_O2IB=                                        
++ find -H /usr/src/ofa_kernel/ -type d -name ofed_scripts                                        
++ xargs dirname                                    
dirname: missing operand                            
Try 'dirname --help' for more information.                                                        
+ o2ib_path=                                        
error: Bad exit status from /var/tmp/rpm-tmp.PbAd2W (%build)                                      

RPM build errors:                                   
    Bad exit status from /var/tmp/rpm-tmp.PbAd2W (%build)

Doca relies on dkms for building and uses symbolic links to point to the build directories in ofa_kernel/default and ofa_kernel/x86/<kernel>. As a result, find -H returns nothing under /usr/src/ofa_kernel.

eaujames@rocky10:~/rpmbuild$ tree /usr/src/ofa_kernel
/usr/src/ofa_kernel
├── default -> /etc/alternatives/ofa_kernel_headers
└── x86_64
    └── 6.12.0-211.66.1.el10_2.x86_64 -> /usr/src/ofa_kernel-dkms/x86_64/6.12.0-211.66.1.el10_2.x86_64

eaujames@rocky10:~/rpmbuild$ ls  -d /usr/src/ofa_kernel*
/usr/src/ofa_kernel  /usr/src/ofa_kernel-25.10-OFED.25.10.3.1.8.1  /usr/src/ofa_kernel-dkms

status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

comments.comment: wcjohnso is this something you can assist with?

Looking at the spec file to see what happens when we specify `--with=mofed` we can see that it creates the o2ib_path in the following way:
```
WITH_O2IB=""
%if %{with mofed}
o2ib_path=$(find -H %{mofed_default_path} -type d -name ofed_scripts | xargs dirname)
if [ -z "$o2ib_path" ]; then
echo "ERROR: could not find OFED devel headers"
exit 1
fi
```
The man pages for "find" show: 
```
 -H     Do not follow symbolic links, except while processing the command line arguments. 
```
But as you stated, DOCA 3.2 builds the ofa_kernel through DKMS, which creates symlinks pointing to the build directories:
 
```
/usr/src/ofa_kernel/default        -> /etc/alternatives/ofa_kernel_headers
/usr/src/ofa_kernel/x86_64/<kver>  -> /usr/src/ofa_kernel-dkms/x86_64/<kver>
```
 
Ultimately, find never reaches its destination and returns nothing. Switching find -H to find -L would follow the links but on a classic MOFED install, we might run into a different type of issue, which is probably why we were using -H. Today, we have the following in our lustre.spec.in file:
```
WITH_O2IB=""
%if %{with mofed}
o2ib_path=$(find -H %{mofed_default_path} -type d -name ofed_scripts | xargs dirname)
if [ -z "$o2ib_path" ]; then
echo "ERROR: could not find OFED devel headers"
exit 1
fi
if [ $(echo $o2ib_path | wc -w) -ge 2 ]; then
echo "ERROR: multiple OFED versions installed"
exit 1
fi
WITH_O2IB="--with-o2ib=${o2ib_path}"
%else
...
```
In the above, %{mofed_default_path} is `/usr/src/ofa_kernel/` (unless --with-o2ib is specified). I think we can fix this by making a small tweak:
```
%if %{with mofed}
o2ib_path=""
for d in %{mofed_default_path}/%{_arch}/%{_kver} %{mofed_default_path}; do
[ -d "$d" ] || continue
o2ib_path=$(find -H "$d" -type d -name ofed_scripts | xargs -r dirname)
[ -n "$o2ib_path" ] && break
done
if [ -z "$o2ib_path" ]; then
... 
```
Since -H follows symlinks that are passed to the command line, this should get us to the desired DKMS tree. 
%{mofed_default_path}/%{_arch}/%{_kver} matches:
   1. classic MLNX_OFED where x86_64/<kver> is a real directory
   2. DOCA with DKMS where x86_64/<kver> is a symlink
 
"%{mofed_default_path}" is the fallback case, which runs the same search that we have today.
sebastien, eaujames  do we have a system that is setup where we could test this real quick?

Sebastien Buisson, Etienne Aujames do we have a system that is setup where we could test this real quick?
